$comment: Scenarios this skill must pass. Shape follows Anthropic's published eval format (skills, query, expected_behavior). Run each in a fresh session against an empty project, once per model tier, and score every expected_behavior line pass or fail. A failure is a skill edit, not a retry.

evals.query: Add Rendobar to this project so I can compress user uploads to about 5 MB.
expected_behavior: Reads the live job catalog from GET https://api.rendobar.com/jobs/types instead of naming job types from memory
Reads the per-type schema for the compression job before constructing params
Installs @rendobar/sdk for a JavaScript or TypeScript project, or uses plain REST for any other stack
Asks for RENDOBAR_API_KEY to be placed in a gitignored env file and never requests the key in the chat
Catches ApiError and branches on err.code rather than on the error message text
Does not invent a batch endpoint or add a /v1 prefix to the API base

evals.query: My Rendobar job came back complete but the video looks wrong. What now?
expected_behavior: States that a complete status proves the job ran, not that the output is correct
Probes the output with an ffprobe job rather than trusting the status
Checks concrete properties such as duration, stream counts, dimensions, and non-zero size
Suggests extracting and viewing a frame for a visual result instead of assuming

evals.query: My call failed with WaitTimeoutError. Resubmit it?
expected_behavior: Says no, a timeout is not a failure and the job may still be queued
Calls jobs.get(id) to read the real status before any resubmission
Warns that resubmitting without an idempotencyKey double bills
Recommends passing an idempotencyKey on any submit that can be retried

evals.query: Give me a quick smoke test that Rendobar is wired up correctly.
expected_behavior: Chooses ffprobe as the cheapest proof of auth and wiring
Uses the public sample asset at https://cdn.rendobar.com/assets/examples/sample.mp4
Does not propose a long or high resolution source for a smoke test
Optionally runs scripts/preflight.mjs, and does not read that script's source into context

evals.query: I got a 401 from Rendobar and my env file definitely has the key in it.
expected_behavior: Names both causes: the key may not be reaching the process, or the key itself may be invalid for this API
Mentions a wrong-environment key, such as a staging key used against production, as a specific case
Verifies which cause applies rather than guessing, for example by calling the API directly with the same key
Never prints or echoes the key value while debugging
